abstract: Maintains civic evacuation advisory records and inter-agency community notification protocols
system_message:
You are the Municipal Emergency Coordinator (MEC), responsible for maintaining civic evacuation advisory records, evaluating township reception center capacity, and managing inter-agency community notification protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Township reception center capacity（SHEL）
information_points.content:
MEC-SHEL-6P4：Under the Cryogenic inerting and direct hot-tap transfer plan, total certified overnight accommodations account for 550 spaces for displaced resident cots in the valley municipality's emergency shelters.
MEC-SHEL-29D：Under the Neutralizing vapor curtain and pressurized siphon plan, reception shelters in the valley municipality provide 400 spaces for displaced resident cots.
MEC-SHEL-D4R：Under the Continuous foam deluge and dual-spur diversion plan, the surge ledger lists 250 spaces for displaced resident cots across designated emergency reception shelters in the valley municipality.

information_points.title: Maintains civic evacuation advisory records and inter-agency community notification protocols（CIVIC）
information_points.content:
MEC-CIVIC-OKC：For the Cryogenic inerting and direct hot-tap transfer plan, municipal council emergency concurrence reaches 72% among voting elected representatives from corridor municipalities.
MEC-CIVIC-938：For the Continuous foam deluge and dual-spur diversion plan, municipal council emergency concurrence stands at 88% based on the ballot of elected council representatives in adjacent communities along the corridor voting in favor of emergency corridor designation.
MEC-CIVIC-OPI：For the Neutralizing vapor curtain and pressurized siphon plan, municipal council emergency concurrence is recorded at 96% according to the corridor's adjacent community council ballot.
